the back of the phone, but nothing happens and no charging light comes on.

Is my phone defective, or is there a specific setting I need to turn on
first? I couldn't figure it out from the quick start guide. Please let me
know the exact steps to get this working.

Thanks, Shubham Customer ID: CUST10001 Purchase Date: 2026-02-15
